metadata.description: Marketplace base de Claude Code: plugins, rules y plantillas comunes a todas tus máquinas.

plugins.name: core-tools
plugins.description: Comandos genéricos: documentación técnica en DOCX y escaneo de secretos.

plugins.name: mcp-n8n
plugins.description: Servidor MCP de n8n (documentación y validación de nodos) vía Docker.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Turn a big task into a tree of agents. A routing skill decides when to decompose work, picks the right fan-out pattern (deep-review, parallel-research, design-tournament, migrate), and drives reusable Workflow scripts with planner/worker/verifier/synthesizer agent archetypes.

plugins.name: webdev-toolkit
plugins.description: Web development discipline: stack defaults, the build-verify-ship loop (drive the real app, not just tests), ship checklists (errors, validation, a11y, perf), client-secret and authorization hard rules, and orchestration hooks for big designs and pre-ship reviews.

plugins.name: scraping-toolkit
plugins.description: Web scraping done right: robots/GDPR/auth-wall gates, an API-first tool ladder, schema-first extraction, anti-brittleness rules (semantic selectors, loud failures, snapshots, idempotent re-runs), and a crawl-extract workflow for URL lists.

plugins.name: analytics-toolkit
plugins.description: Data analysis discipline: the pull-profile-analyze-visualize-report pipeline, statistical rigor rules (effect sizes, denominators, confounders, seasonality, distributions, multiple comparisons), honest-uncertainty reporting, and dataviz-skill integration for charts.

plugins.name: database-toolkit
plugins.description: Database discipline: destructive-SQL gates (state loss, verify backup, confirm), environment echo before mutations, expand-migrate-contract migration discipline with reversibility, schema rules that model access patterns, and a query review checklist (EXPLAIN, indexes, N+1s, parameterization).

plugins.name: security-toolkit
plugins.description: Defensive security for everyday shipping: 10-minute threat models, per-entry-point review checklist (injection, authZ/IDOR, secrets, crypto, uploads), dependency/supply-chain routine, incident basics, and deep-review orchestration for full audits. Authorized-defensive scope only.

plugins.name: devops-toolkit
plugins.description: CI/CD and infrastructure discipline: deploy gates (dry-run first, prod confirmation, rollback path stated), fail-fast pipeline conventions, IaC rules (no console drift, sacred state), container hygiene (non-root, no secrets in layers), and the observability minimum.

plugins.name: maintenance-toolkit
plugins.description: Codebase upkeep: the dependency-bump ritual (batch patch/minor, changelog-first majors, security jumps the queue), evidence-based dead-code sweeps, the quarterly repo health checklist, and migrate-codebase orchestration for wide cleanups.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Externo (MIT, leonxlnx): skills de gusto de diseño frontend, imagen a código y kits de marca.

plugins.name: hyperframes
plugins.description: Externo (Apache-2.0, HeyGen): crear y renderizar vídeo desde HTML; animación, audio, keyframes y medios.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Externo (Apache-2.0, pbakaus): diseño, crítica y pulido de interfaces, con sus agentes.
